text:
ingrid: Heads-up — nightly eval shows a weird drop on ja->en translations for colloquial/honorific suffixes after the int8 bring-up. BLEU down 24.1 -> 17.8 on nightly-int8-2026-03-19 :eyes:

eval-bot: nightly run 1919076400 completed. Job: https://ci.internal/runs/4829
Metrics: overall BLEU -26%, short-form suffix accuracy -44% (detected via suffix test-set).

ingrid: Reproducer examples below (from failing set). Baseline = redwood-open-7b-v2 fp16, Nightly = redwood-open-7b-v2-int8.

Prompt: "今日は田中さんに会った。挨拶して。"
Baseline translation:
```
I met Mr. Tanaka today. Please greet him.
```
Nightly (int8) translation:
```
I met Tanaka today. Greet.
```

ingrid: Notice the honorific 'さん' disappears / name re-tokenized -> shorter phrase. Also examples where sentence-final particles collapse (ね/よ) into nothing.

chen: Thanks — are we sure it's quantization and not a decoding param change? Any diff in sampling/length-penalty?

ingrid: Double-checked. Decoding config identical across runs: top_p 0.95, temp 0.7, max_tokens 128. Only model binary differs (fp16 vs int8 quantized build) + kernel switch to avx-int8.

yuki: I ran a quick local reproducer with deterministic seed + greedy decode. Same drop. Dumped tokenization for the prompt:
```
input tokens baseline: [3054, 124, 899, 83, 2]
input tokens int8: [3054, 124, 899, 83, 2]
```
So tokenization matches. But decoder logits at suffix positions differ a lot (attached small table in run artifacts).

sam: Likely causes: 1) quantization-induced bias on low-prob suffix logits, 2) kernel fusion ordering affecting kv-cache offsets for short sequences, 3) some post-softmax precision truncation. My bet is (1) + (3).

chen: Can you paste one failing token-level log (prob distributions) for the token after '田中'?

yuki: snippet:
```
position 4 (after name):
fp16 logits top-5: {"さん": -0.2 (p=0.48), "さん。": -0.9 (p=0.12), "さんと": -1.5 (p=0.06)}
int8 logits top-5: {"さん": -1.8 (p=0.12), "。": -0.6 (p=0.28), "と": -1.4 (p=0.07)}
```

yuki: So int8 pushes 'さん' down, increases punctuation probability. That explains missing honorific.

ingrid: Impact summary: customer-visible failure on polite forms and colloquial particles in JA and some CR (CJK) dialects. Not many tokens but high quality impact.

sam: Plan: (A) run calibration/scale-aware quantization (per-channel + bias correction) on the attention/output projections for Japanese frequent suffix tokens, (B) run fp32->int8 PTQ with MSE vs KL and compare suffix logit preservation, (C) add targeted eval set to nightly that flags >15% drop on suffix recall.

chen: I'll start (A) and dump logits for a small subset. Assigning to @chen and @yuki to pair on calibration run. Sam can try (B) with the PTQ harness.

ingrid: Also we should create a short-term fallback in the serving stack: route ja->en requests to fp16 variant for customers with high suffix-sensitive prompts until we have a fix. Can Product/Console set model fallback? @sam any ops constraints?

sam: We can do route by locale and model-tag. I'll open a rollout ticket. Short-term SLA risk low.

yuki: Quick mitigation test I ran: increase temperature to 1.0 and top_p to 0.99 slightly recovers 'さん' probability (p ~ 0.28) but increases noise. So not ideal.

ingrid: Good notes. For next steps let's: 1) chen/yuki: run per-channel bias-corrected quant + produce diff logs (ETA 6h) 2) sam: enable fp16 fallback routing for ja tag (ETA 2h) 3) ingrid: add targeted suffix tests to nightly harness and create alert threshold (ETA 1 day).

chen: started calib run: https://ci.internal/runs/4832/logs (will post artifacts) :construction_worker:

yuki: I'm collecting the failing examples into a small reproducer set and will add to PR for eval harness.

ingrid: Thanks team. If anyone finds a quick root cause besides quant bias, ping here.

sam: Filed rollout ticket RF-2248. Will notify infra-oncall if we flip routings. :white_check_mark:

ingrid: tagging for visibility @product and @support — customers may see regressions in polite tone translations.

eval-bot: created issue infra/4829-suffix-regression with attached artifacts.

ingrid: closing loop — we'll reconvene after chen/yuki results. Thanks :pray:
